name: Pakistan National Council of the Arts and National Art Gallery
assumptions: Main front bearing 235 degrees is taken from the Esri plan and the portal photos; the dossier had none.
All heights are estimates from door and window proportions in the photos: main parapet 17 m, portal 15.5 m, twin towers 21.5 m; no measured height exists.
The second tower is placed by symmetry with the first, supported by matching roof hatches on the Esri plan; photos show it only at a distance.
A lower wall seen just left of the portal in one photo is not modelled as a separate forward wing because the plan does not confirm it.
The dashed dark squares in the stone bands and the stair aisle through the seating are left out at this budget.
Roof outlines come from a leaning satellite image shifted forward by 7.5 m; wall positions may be 3 to 8 m out.
Window positions on the rear and side walls are a plain regular grid because no photo shows those sides.
Brick colour is sampled from news and book photos; the dossier had no eye-level value.
The blocks are placed flat at one ground level although the sources say the site is a small hillock; the seating is shown rising 3.6 m from the stage.
The stage house and low screen walls are read only from the Esri plan; their heights are guesses.
The court walls beyond the one photographed bay repeat that bay.
Temporary banners and the veiled figure sculptures are left out.
